title: Tom's Plan — 8-week rebuild
structure: Staffs + NFRS bleep 8.8 · Avon Cooper 1.5 mile · Mon capped bleep/speed · Fri tempo · Cooper Sat 22 Aug + Sat 12 Sep · full MSFT Oct 5 + Oct 26

days.note: Shakeout — start here
Optional Easy 3K if legs feel good — default is rest
Skipped — too tired / run down
Optional PFTC — skip if tired
🔥 Fire baseline — 5.2 then 6.2 (~5:27/km at L6) · strength deferred
Recovery after bleep — keep it short
Feeling rough — skip full MSFT · Easy 4K then 6–8× 20m @ L7 5:13/km · full walk recoveries · stop early if flat
Warm up: 5' jog + 6× 20m turn drills (walk recover) · then 4× L7 (~6.3s) + 4× L8 (6.0s) with full walks · Tue easy before Wed full
Easy Zone 2 — conversational · freshen up for Wed full practice

1) Inhaler · 2) ankles/calves/leg swings off-watch · 3) 5' easy jog · 4) 4× light 20m turns + walk · 5) Spotify full MSFT L1→fail — pace L1–4 easy, aim 7.0+ · 6) 5' easy jog cool-down · fuel after · no BAC/PFTC
Easy only before Gower — strength deferred · no BAC
Easy only — keep it light before Gower
Gower — optional easy only if legs feel good · not prescribed
10' easy + 4× strides · 4× 400m @ 4:50-4:55/km + 4× 400m @ 4:40-4:45/km · 90s walk recoveries · 5' cool · proper speed work
Fartlek — 10' easy warm-up + 20' fartlek: mix 1-3 min surges at L6-L8 pace, easy jog recoveries between + 5' cool-down = ~35' total · fun, varied, builds aerobic speed
Recovery — knackered after Mon/Tue. Walk/jog 2:1 on flat · skip run club · no PFTC · stop at 30 min if legs drop
days.runPlan: Walk/jog recovery — 2 min walk / 1 min jog

days.note: 💪 Strength WK4 — circuit for time · Avon WT press/pull @ gym optional · NFRS carries
Tempo — 10' easy + 20' tempo (~5:20-5:30/km, comfortably hard) + 5' cool = ~35' total · threshold work for Cooper + bleep
First week of new structure — legs adjusting to varied pace work
Cancelled — rest. Heat + DOMS week — do not chase missed speed
Heat deload — easy conversational only, early or shade · skip if still wiped · no surges

Feeling recovered — back to structured speed · 10' easy + 4× strides · 4× 400m @ 4:50-4:55/km + 4× 400m @ 4:40-4:45/km · 90s walk recoveries · 5' cool · still heat/DOMS week so ease off if it doesn't feel right
💪 Strength WK5 light circuit — cut rounds if legs still sore · cool gym, no hero lifts
Heat deload — easy only, no tempo · early/shade · skip if HR feels high for pace
Short long — easy, early start · shade routes · walk breaks fine · heat > ego
days.foodWeight: Pudding ok tonight. Fuel + fluids after.

days.note: Illness — skipped speed 400s. Do not make this up later in the week
Rest — still illness week. Stay in if symptoms linger
Skip unless clearly better (no fever, energy back). If you go: easy conversational only, cut short is fine · no PFTC
Cautious return to speed — 10' easy + 4× strides · 5× 400m @ 5:00-5:10/km (controlled, not max) · full 2' walk recoveries · 5' cool · stop early if breathing/legs flare
💪 Strength WK2 — Build circuit, carried over from Thu (bumped for speed work) · no hero lifts
Avon WT Cooper marker — only if 24h+ symptom-free. If still ill: rest or easy 20'. Warm up 10–15 min + strides · log time · aim toward 12 min (~5:00/km)
